{{Quote|We have a contact on Kaon: Major Byzal, head of local security.|[[Darth Nurin]]|<ref name="KUS" />}}
The '''Kaon Security''' was the [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary security]] organization of [[Kaon]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era. Kaon Security forces included troopers, commando and officers. They also used [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] such as [[Kaon Sentinel Mk. III|Kaon Sentinels Mk. III]] and [[KR-82 Expulser]]s.<ref name="KUS" />

==History==
{{Quote|The plague's spiraling out of control. The rakghouls are getting stronger. The virus isn't just infecting sentients anymore. It's spreading through the local wildlife. My patrols have no idea how to handle it.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Byzal]]|<ref name="KUS" />}}
During the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] on Kaon,<ref name="KUS" /> in [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> the Kaon Security quarantined the planet and tried to control the situation. Nevertheless, despite the arrival of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] reinforcements, Kaon Security troops were completely overwhelmed and most of them were killed or turned in [[rakghoul]]s, including [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Byzal]].<ref name="KUS" />
